channel.title: HormuzTracker.tech — Strait of Hormuz Crisis Monitor
channel.description: Real-time Strait of Hormuz monitoring. Track shipping disruptions, oil prices, vessel seizures, insurance status, and global trade impact.

item.title: US Strikes Iranian Missile Sites Near Hormuz in Defensive Operation
item.description: CENTCOM confirms precision strikes on Qeshm Island targets and IRGC mine-laying vessels near the Strait of Hormuz. Operation Sentinel Strike deployed 14 precision-guided munitions.

item.title: Ceasefire Framework Emerges After Beijing-Mediated Marathon Talks
item.description: China brokers 60-day truce extension framework between US and Iran, with phased strait reopening and sanctions relief as key provisions.

item.title: Brent Surges Past $102 as Military Strikes Dampen Peace Deal Hopes
item.description: Oil prices spike 2.7% in a single session as US military strikes interrupt diplomatic progress, with analysts warning of further escalation premium.

item.title: Three Vessels Cross Hormuz Under Diplomatic Escort as Talks Continue
item.description: Two LNG carriers and one oil tanker pass through the strait in the first commercial transit in 72 hours, escorted by international naval vessels.

item.title: India Declares Fuel Emergency as Reserve Levels Hit Critical Threshold
item.description: The Indian government activates emergency fuel rationing protocols as strategic petroleum reserves fall below 15 days of coverage for the first time.

item.title: EU Gas Prices Hit Record as Qatar Force Majeure Enters Third Month
item.description: TTF gas futures surge to all-time highs as European utilities scramble for alternative LNG supplies amid prolonged Qatar export disruption.

item.title: US Naval Escort Operation Completes Fifth Convoy Through Hormuz
item.description: Operation Freedom of Navigation escorts its fifth convoy of commercial vessels through the Strait of Hormuz amid ongoing security threats.

item.title: Beijing Summit: Can China Broker a Deal?
item.description: China's emergency summit brings together Iran, Saudi Arabia, UAE, and Oman for 48-hour continuous negotiations on strait reopening.

item.title: Iran's Safe Transit Proposal: Genuine or Stalling?
item.description: Iran's proposed safe transit corridor comes with conditions that make acceptance unlikely, according to Western diplomatic sources.

item.title: Operation Freedom of Navigation: The Naval Escort Mission
item.description: The US-led naval escort operation has completed three convoy transits through the Strait of Hormuz amid escalating regional tensions.
